svg.aria-label: Constructed scattering from 80 nm spheres, seed 810, 633 nm, 90°, medium index 1.333. Two independent complex Gaussian modes plus Poisson counts; 1048576 bins of 2 μs. Display: first 10 ms; correlation uses full record. Fit delays ≤6 ms, excluding zero lag. Panel D includes all displayed delays.
